summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 9001 Lead Auditor exam and practise QMS audit planning, evidence evaluation, and nonconformity reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate ISO 9001 QMS conformity, plan audits, or communicate audit findings and conclusions.
prerequisites: To participate, you should have a fundamental understanding of ISO 9001 QMS requirements and comprehensive knowledge of audit principles.
